workflow.rule: Read the workflow files first before any task.
workflow.decision_gate: Any plot or canon change must be validated by Codex before implementation.
workflow.legacy_policy: Old files are archive reference, not active canon unless approved.
workflow.converted_legacy_policy: Once legacy material is converted into .md records, those files are review-only and not active working source material unless explicitly re-approved.
workflow.writing_policy: Gemini writes from approved planning, not from ad-hoc invention.
workflow.chapter_creation_rule: Every new chapter must be created from kiro/chapters/chapter-template.md and must keep the same structural sections across all chapter files. Every chapter creation also requires a writing-bible compliance check before it is considered valid.
